summary: This Form 6-K filed by Brookfield Corporation contains a press release announcing only the scheduling of its second quarter 2026 earnings results conference call and webcast for August 13, 2026. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is disclosed. The filing is a routine notice of an earnings release date with no special-situation content. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category. As a foreign private issuer, this equates to a standard earnings announcement filing, not a special situation.
